theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), T.boundary = 0 → ∀ (a : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ U → ∀ (j : Fin (m + 1)) (ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1)), (∀ x, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = fderiv ℝ a x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) → T ω = 0
